candidates.summary: Use optional RUN-scoped CA secret consumption, and cold isolated verification, to separate dependency trust from daemon and runtime trust.
candidates.evidence: Both exact production Dockerfiles failed without workspace CA, succeeded with existing CA, and failed with invalid CA; unchanged ordinary GitHub CI also passed both image jobs. Secret contents are not cache keys; overlapping probes were excluded.
candidates.scope: BuildKit builds behind an already authorized custom TLS issuer; does not authorize new trust, disabled TLS, publication, deployment or independent acceptance.
